editorial:
Picture a guy who has his life down to a routine: gym, church, family dinners, nights out with the boys, and a steady stream of porn that he enjoys more than actual sex. That is Jon, a New Jersey bartender who thinks he has everything figured out until he meets Barbara, a gorgeous woman who seems like the perfect catch. The movie follows Jon as his carefully built world starts to crack, forcing him to question what real intimacy actually looks like. It is funny, honest, and surprisingly heartfelt, with a tone that feels like hanging out with your buddies while also getting a little real about relationships.

Joseph Gordon-Levitt directs and stars, and he brings a confident, energetic style that keeps things moving. Scarlett Johansson is fantastic as Barbara, and Julianne Moore steals scenes as an older woman who sees right through Jon. The film does not shy away from awkward moments, which makes it feel genuine rather than polished. Some viewers might find the porn-focused humor a bit much, but it serves the story well. If you enjoy character-driven comedies with heart, this is a great pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Jon breaks up with Barbara after she discovers his porn habit and realizes he cannot meet her impossible standards. He then grows closer to Esther, an older woman who teaches him that real intimacy is about connection, not performance. The movie ends with Jon watching porn but choosing to turn it off, symbolizing his growth. He walks away from fantasy and steps into a more honest, vulnerable version of himself, finally ready for a real relationship.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves character-driven comedies with honest takes on relationships.
